name: Sweet Lassi
description: Cool Pakistani sweet lassi blended from chilled yogurt with sugar, cardamom and water or milk until creamy and frothy.
ingredients: 1 cup chilled water or milk, added gradually for the preferred thickness
method: Add the chilled yogurt to a blender and blend briefly until completely smooth.
Add most of the water or milk and the sugar, then blend until creamy and frothy.
Taste after dilution and adjust the sweetness before adding more liquid.
Add the cardamom and ice and pulse briefly so the drink becomes cold without being unnecessarily diluted.
Check the consistency, adding the remaining water or milk only if needed, then serve immediately while frothy and chilled.
